summary: parks.ca.gov page + posted orders + 2009 brochure + ReserveCalifornia RDR (place 665, facilities 539/542, grid + details) + imagery read. $45 standard / $60 electric (+$15), no weekend difference; 128 units, all 31 ft, back-in, paved; 44 bookable electric sites 20/30/50 A (stored electric 0 was wrong); flush, token showers, dump, store; year-round; max stay 15. Not waterfront kept (PCH and the day-use lot lie between camp and beach). Pin fine. Phone 310-457-8143 -> 310-457-8144.
flags: HOOKUPS CORRECTED: stored electric 0 -> 50. ReserveCalifornia lists 48 'Hook Up (E )' sites (44 bookable online) with 20/30/50 A pedestals, and parks.ca.gov confirms the amperages. Water and sewer stay false: the only E/W/S unit (L044) is not publicly bookable.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Both loops are north of the four-lane Pacific Coast Highway in Arroyo Sequit canyon; the highway (and the day-use lot) lies between camp and shore, which rules out coastal walk/coastal woods under the coastal rule. The canyon is a seasonal creek bed under sycamores, not a water body.
PHONE: 310-457-8143 (the 2009 brochure's number) -> 310-457-8144 (parks.ca.gov 'Contact Information' and 'General Information').
COUNT: stored 135 -> 128 (74 + 54 units in the RDR grid; site numbers run 1-139 with gaps). Hike-and-bike and en route sites are not in the grid and are not counted.

CLOSURE ORDER: parks.ca.gov still links order 915-21-004 closing the campground from 2021-12-31 after the December 2021 flood; it is clearly superseded (nights selling now, in season through winter), so status is open. Current restriction is only 'North Beach Access Road Closed due to tidal water / rain water in underpass'. Red-flag days close trails and backcountry; the 2026 protocol keeps campgrounds open.
MAX STAY 15: RDR Restrictions MaximumStay 15 for both facilities (booking window currently to 2027-05-27; summer limits not yet visible).
No maximum trailer/motorhome length is posted on parks.ca.gov page_id=616 any more; 31 ft comes from every RDR unit's VehicleLength and Pad Length.
